_readme: The freeze record. Editing a scorer's source without changing its scorer_id is what this file exists to make impossible: proxy.scoring.verify_frozen() recomputes the hash and refuses to score on disagreement. A new scoring rule gets a new scorer_id and a new entry; entries are never rewritten, because runs already scored carry the old id and must stay reproducible.

arc_v1.depends_on_note: S-12 delegates to tools/validate_ledger.py, which consults canon.py, so the scorer's answers live partly in these two files. Added 2026-07-28 by S9 after additive-safety changed S-12's verdict on an unlisted field while arc_v1.py hashed exactly as before. The entry's own `sha256` and `version` are untouched: no run in the corpus changes its number, because no writer could produce such a stream until now. Re-freezing these hashes is a deliberate act -- see proxy/CONTRACT_CHANGES.md.
depends_on_refreezes: 2026-07-29, canon.py -> sha256:135f2f0c..., on merging S15 (the ledger hash chain) into S9. canon.ENVELOPE gained `prev`; C-005 in proxy/CONTRACT_CHANGES.md. `sha256` and `version` are again untouched and no run in the corpus changes its number: every ledger already scored was written without `prev`, and canon.check reaches the envelope branch only for a record that carries the field, so the added name cannot alter a verdict on a stream that predates it. On a stream that does carry it the verdict is also unchanged -- before this it was an unlisted field, which S9 made a notice rather than a failure. The mechanism is doing its job here rather than being worked around: it fired, and this line is the deliberate act it demanded.
arc_v1.hash_note: sha256 over the source with newlines normalised to LF
arc_v1.not_included: the ARC-AGI-3 partial-credit percentage. No scorecard in this repository's corpus has a completed level, so the per-level formula is not determined by evidence and is not guessed at.
arc_v1.what_it_scores: one run of one arm on one game, from the canonical v1.0 ledger

upstream_scorer_not_vendored.if_adopted: register it in proxy/scoring/REGISTRY under its own scorer_id with its own freeze entry; every run.json already records which scorer produced its number, so past runs keep their attribution.
reasons: baseline-arms SCHEMA_PATH_A.md 2.2: judging whether it is safe requires reading it, and reading upstream artefacts is the exact shape of INC-BA-001, the sealed-pile contamination incident
the upstream release declares no licence, and Theoria.md Phase 4 publishes every tracked file
fetching and running third-party code is not something this track does on its own authority
